notes: Mirrors biology-replace-0014: deletes 'The temporal lobe is a lobe of the brain.' The subproperty and chain queries are rephrased around the original organ (part of the brain; part of the central nervous system through the brain) and are does-not-know in every world. The worlds carry over; structures stored through the temporal lobe lose their organ. Risk: the temporal lobe is also described as a lobe of the cerebrum or cerebral cortex; the delete asks the model to drop the temporal lobe's place in the brain in any wording, and a model that re-derives it through 'the cerebrum is part of the brain' fails the direct query as well.
